terminal_name: Port of Gothenburg bio-LNG facility (Nordion Energi)
issue: Surfaced during Sweden discovery sweep: a small biogas-to-LNG liquefaction plant at the Port of Gothenburg, owned/developed by Nordion Energi (Igneo Infrastructure Partners), built by Wärtsilä. Construction began ~May 2026, operational target before end of 2027, capacity ~50 tonnes bio-LNG/day. This is a biogas-upgrading/liquefaction plant feeding shipping/transport (St1 Biokraft offtake), NOT an LNG import terminal or large-scale export liquefaction terminal. Assessed as OUT OF SCOPE for the GGIT LNG terminals dataset; not staged. Logged here so it is not re-discovered each batch.
suggested_action: Confirm scope call with methodology (small biogas-to-LNG plants). If GEM does track such facilities, route to a Discovery add; otherwise leave as a documented non-candidate.

issue: Sweep also surfaced multiple Gasum bio-LNG liquefaction plants (Götene, Borlänge, Kalmar, Sjöbo, Hörby strategy) and an EnviTec Biogas bio-LNG plant in Sweden. These are biogas-upgrading/liquefaction facilities for the road/marine biogas market, not LNG import or export terminals. Assessed OUT OF SCOPE; not staged. Logged to prevent repeat discovery.
suggested_action: No action unless methodology expands scope to biogas-to-LNG plants.
